description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for a User entity in a banking application, including methods for retrieving user info, account details, and message counts, as well as pre-save and pre-remove hooks for password hashing and cleanup.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Mongoose model representing a user in the system.

methods.name: getBasic
methods.description: Returns a sanitized user object with basic info and stats like account details and message count.

methods.name: getAccsDetails
methods.description: Retrieves the total balance and count of accounts owned by the user.

methods.name: getMessagesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of messages received by the user.
